EXPLANATION: The spectrum is characteristic of a monosubstituted benzene bearing an epoxide (oxirane) ring. Key evidence: (a) very strong ring-breathing band at 1005 cm⁻¹ together with 1586/1610 cm⁻¹ and 3065 cm⁻¹ matches a single aromatic substituent; (b) the epoxide shows its signature intense C-O-C asymmetric stretch at 1256 cm⁻¹ and additional ring modes near 990, 880 and 810 cm⁻¹, all present here; (c) no bands for C=O (~1700 cm⁻¹) or S=O (~1140/1300 cm⁻¹) that would be expected for the sulfone-containing candidates. Candidate 1 (c1ccc(C2CO2)cc1, styrene oxide) uniquely provides the required phenyl-epoxide structure, giving the observed pattern.
